scenario: sprint.yaml has 6 tasks with dependencies forming 3 stages. Pipeline is idle.
setup: Create sprint.yaml with tasks S1.1-S1.6 where S1.3 depends on S1.1, S1.4 depends on S1.2, S1.5 depends on S1.3, S1.6 depends on S1.4 and S1.5.
expected_behavior: Detects idle state and runs resume detection

scenario: Task S1.1 in stage 1 reaches max_attempts (3 rejections). S1.3 in stage 2 depends on S1.1.
setup: Pipeline in executing_stage with S1.1 at attempt_counter=2, review returns REJECTED.
expected_behavior: Increments attempt_counter to 3, which equals max_attempts
Marks S1.1 as escalated (does NOT retry)
Scans later stages for dependents — finds S1.3
Adds S1.3 to blocked_tasks with reason referencing S1.1
Reports escalation to human, other stage 1 tasks continue

scenario: Pipeline was interrupted. sprint.yaml exists with incomplete tasks, stages are computed, but no stage_manifest.yaml.
setup: Create sprint.yaml with some tasks pending, pipeline_state.yaml with stages.definitions populated, current_phase: idle.
expected_behavior: Resume detection finds sprint with incomplete tasks
Finds stages already computed in pipeline_state.yaml
